about: Real outputs of the pinned tools for adapter regression cases (adapters fix, 2026-10-22). Each outcome was produced by running the argv the adapter builds for the case with the pinned tool versions outside the analyzer image (PyPI wheels on host Python 3.14; the lockfile's ESLint/jscpd on Node 24; the sha256-verified gitleaks 8.30.1 binary), paths mapped to the sandbox's /src, /out, /tmp/llmlab-src, /tmp/llmlab-cwd and /tmp/scan (the same /tmp hierarchy as the container). The same procedure reproduced the image-captured golden outputs byte for byte. tests/test_adapters_regressions_docker.py runs the same cases and expectations in the image. Host-interpreter DeprecationWarnings on stderr (Python 3.14 only) were dropped.
